title: Blade Harvest
subtitle: Fruit Slicer Arcade
description: Slice juicy fruits across the screen, dodge dangerous bombs, and chain massive combo multipliers in this fast-paced arcade game.

controls.mouse: Click & Drag across fruits to slice
controls.keyboard: P / Esc to Pause, M to Mute, Space to Launch

features: Procedural fruit graphics & juice particle physics
Arcade 60s Blitz & Classic 3-Lives Modes
Web Audio procedural sound effects

title: Chroma Breaker
subtitle: Cyber Brick Arcade
description: Shatter vibrant neon bricks with an energy pulse ball. Control paddle spin, angle your rebounds, and clear the grid without losing a life.

controls.keyboard: Left / Right Arrow (or A / D) to steer, Space to launch

features: Dynamic spin paddle physics & glowing ball trail
Multi-tier color bricks with point rewards
Synthesized retro chimes & spark particles

title: Neon Snake
subtitle: Cyber Slither Grid
description: Slither through a pulsating neon cyber grid. Munch glowing energy bits, dodge walls and your own tail, and grab bonus star power-ups.

controls.touch: Swipe screen or tap responsive D-pad
controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or W, A, S, D to steer

features: Dynamic speed scaling as snake grows
Special timed bonus stars & energy power-ups
Web Audio synthesized turn & eat sound effects

title: Space Invaders
subtitle: Galactic Defense Arcade
description: Command your star fighter against relentless waves of descending alien formations. Blast invaders, dodge plasma bombs, and defeat epic bosses.

controls.mouse: Drag ship left/right, click to shoot
controls.touch: Drag finger to steer, tap fire button
controls.keyboard: Left / Right Arrow (or A, D) to move, Space to fire

features: Multi-tier alien squadrons with unique attacks
Intense Mothership Boss battles and wave progression
Explosive particle bursts & synthesized laser FX

title: Neon Rush
subtitle: Endless Cyber Runner
description: Sprint down an endless synthwave highway at breakneck speed. Leap over laser spikes, slide under plasma gates, and collect glowing power-ups.

controls.touch: Swipe Up to Jump, Swipe Down to Slide
controls.keyboard: Up / Space to Jump, Down / S to Slide

features: Gradual speed acceleration & distance tracker
Magnet, Shield, and 2x Multiplier power-ups
Synthwave perspective grid & neon sun aesthetics

title: 2048 Puzzle
subtitle: Neon Number Merger
description: Slide and merge matching neon number tiles to reach the legendary 2048 tile. Features silky smooth merge animations, undo move, and high scores.

controls.mouse: Click & Drag in direction to slide
controls.touch: Swipe Left, Right, Up, or Down
controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or W, A, S, D to slide tiles

features: Silky animated tile transitions & merge pulses
Undo last move & restart at any time
Harmonic synth chords that ascend with tile value

title: Whack-a-Mole
subtitle: Cyber Bot Reaction
description: Test your reflexes against mischievous cyber bots popping out of neon portals. Whack gold bots for bonus points and avoid explosive glitch bombs!

controls.mouse: Click directly on popping cyber bots
controls.touch: Tap bots on touchscreen before they retreat

features: 4 Bot Types: Standard, Golden, Glitch Bomb, Time Freeze
Dynamic 60s countdown & combo multiplier streak
Electric mallet impact sparks & synthesized audio

title: Memory Master
subtitle: Cyber Sequence Simon
description: Challenge your visual and auditory recall. Watch the four glowing neon quadrants pulse with harmonic synth chimes and repeat the sequence.

controls.keyboard: 1, 2, 3, 4 or Q, W, A, S or Arrow keys

features: 4 Distinct musical frequencies & neon glow ripples
Increasing sequence length & speed progression
Level tracking, best streak, and audio visualizer
